findings.summary: Done-when `pnpm typecheck` exits 1 on two runs (logs typecheck-1.log and typecheck-2.log, exit codes 1). All 3 errors are in files owned by phase-5-frontend-owner-home (wave 10): OwnerHome.tsx(5,36) TS2305 HomeTrendPoint not exported by @/api/homeApi; OwnerHome.tsx(198,35) TS2339 'trend' missing on OwnerHomeData; ScoreTrend.tsx(1,15) TS2305 HomeTrendPoint. No error is reported in ConsultantHome.tsx, CompaniesPage.tsx, ReevaluationSection.tsx or SettingsPage.tsx. Not a defect of this unit; the Done-when cannot pass until the wave-10 owner-home unit removes trend/HomeTrendPoint and deletes ScoreTrend.tsx.

Capability e2e not run by this unit: `pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/home.spec.ts tests/e2e/settings.spec.ts tests/e2e/companies.spec.ts tests/e2e/firstRun.spec.ts tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts`. These are capability-level checks for integration and depend on the wave-10 owner-home unit; they were not run here.
Play dev-link walkthrough for the settings and consultant home screens was not run; no running Play host is available in this QA session. Integration must run it after the wave-10 unit lands.

messages.text: After phase-5-frontend-owner-home (wave 10) removes HomeTrendPoint/trend from OwnerHome.tsx and deletes ScoreTrend.tsx, rerun `pnpm typecheck` (expected exit 0). Then run `pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/home.spec.ts tests/e2e/settings.spec.ts tests/e2e/companies.spec.ts tests/e2e/firstRun.spec.ts tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts` and the Play dev-link walkthrough. Until the rerun passes, this unit's Done-when stays unverified.

The companies list filter from the prototype is ?filtro=, but this unit implements ?atencao= (attention) and keeps ?estagio= (stage). E2e authors should use ?atencao=. Phase 6 should add an 'aguardando' value to CompanyAttention and a matching card in AttentionWidgets.

Reported by the implementer, not re-verified by QA: OnboardingTour.tsx consultant step 'Hora de refazer' still says 'mais de 90 dias', while ConsultantHome now uses data.reevaluationDays. New anchor data-aioson-id='consult-attention' is available.
